label: New collecting systems, 2 000 p.e. and above
definition: New collecting systems in agglomerations of 2 000 p.e. and above.

label: New collecting systems, 1 000 to 1 999 p.e.
definition: New collecting systems in agglomerations of 1 000 to 1 999 p.e.

label: Measures to reduce storm water overflows
definition:
Measures to reduce storm water overflows from collecting systems, so that they meet Part A
of Annex I.

label: Measures for individual systems
definition: Measures for individual systems used where a collecting system is not established.

label: Measures resulting from a management plan
definition: Measures resulting from an integrated urban wastewater management plan.

label: New collecting systems, below 1 000 p.e.
definition:
New collecting systems in agglomerations below 1 000 p.e., on the basis of the risk
assessment.

label: Renew or replace existing collecting systems
definition: Renewal or replacement of existing collecting system infrastructure.

label: New plant, agglomerations of 2 000 p.e. and above
definition: A new treatment plant providing secondary treatment.

label: New plant, agglomerations of 1 000 to 1 999 p.e.
definition: A new treatment plant providing secondary treatment.

label: Upgrade to tertiary treatment (N)
definition: Upgrade to tertiary treatment for nitrogen.

label: Upgrade to tertiary treatment (P)
definition: Upgrade to tertiary treatment for phosphorus.

label: Upgrade to tertiary treatment (N+P)
definition: Upgrade to tertiary treatment for both nitrogen and phosphorus.

label: Upgrade to quaternary treatment
definition: Upgrade to quaternary treatment for micropollutants.

label: Energy neutrality
definition: Measures to meet the renewable energy targets.

label: Secondary treatment, agglomerations below 1 000 p.e.
definition: Applying secondary treatment on the basis of the risk assessment.

label: Tertiary treatment, agglomerations below 10 000 p.e.
definition: Applying tertiary treatment on the basis of the risk assessment.

label: Quaternary treatment, agglomerations below 10 000 p.e.
definition: Applying quaternary treatment on the basis of the risk assessment.

label: Stricter treatment requirements
definition: Applying stricter requirements for treatment on the basis of the risk assessment.

label: Other appropriate measure
definition: Another appropriate measure under Article 18(2). Describe it in `measureText`.

label: Renew or replace existing treatment plants
definition: Renewal or replacement of an existing treatment plant, including capacity increase.
